summary: High-performance systems programming with zero-overhead abstractions, RAII resource management, and modern generic STL.

rows.means: standard stream input/output library
rows.consequence: Type-safe stream operators (<< and >>) replace C's printf format specifiers, automatically formatting any custom object.

rows.means: user-defined types: private by default / public by default
rows.consequence: In C++, classes and structs are identical except for default visibility: class members are private by default; struct members are public.

rows.means: initialization on creation / automated cleanup on destruction
rows.consequence: The destructor runs deterministically as soon as an object goes out of scope, releasing memory, closing sockets, or freeing locks.

rows.means: binds lifecycle of physical resources to C++ object scope
rows.consequence: The core architectural superpower of C++. Guarantees no resource leaks even if unexpected exceptions are thrown.

rows.means: contiguous, dynamically resizing heap array
rows.consequence: The default collection in C++. Provides O(1) random access and cache-friendly contiguous memory locality.

rows.means: dynamically resizing managed character string
rows.consequence: Automatically handles memory allocation and null termination, eliminating C-style buffer overflow vulnerabilities.

rows.means: hash table offering average O(1) key-value lookups
rows.consequence: Requires Key to implement std::hash and equality operator (==); use std::map if you need keys kept in sorted order.

rows.means: smart pointer with exclusive, single ownership of a heap resource
rows.consequence: Cannot be copied, only moved (std::move). Automatically deletes the underlying resource when the pointer goes out of scope.

rows.means: smart pointer with reference-counted shared ownership
rows.consequence: Maintains an atomic reference counter. Frees the resource only when the last shared_ptr pointing to it is destroyed.

rows.means: casts an lvalue to an rvalue to transfer ownership without copying
rows.consequence: Eliminates expensive deep copies of vectors, strings, and buffers by simply stealing their internal heap pointers.

rows.means: instructs the compiler to deduce the type automatically
rows.consequence: auto it = map.begin() deduces std::unordered_map<std::string, int>::iterator without verbose manual type typing.

rows.means: defines generic functions or classes instantiated at compile time
rows.consequence: Generates zero-overhead specialized machine code for each concrete type used, delivering high speed with generic reuse.

rows.means: forces code execution and value computation at compile time
rows.consequence: Enables complex mathematical tables or validation logic to run during compilation, resulting in zero runtime CPU cycles.

rows.means: anonymous inline function object with variable capture
rows.consequence: [=] captures outer variables by value; [&] captures by reference. Essential for algorithms like std::sort and multithreading.

rows.means: defines an abstract method interface that derived classes must implement
rows.consequence: Enables runtime polymorphism via virtual method tables (vtables), allowing base class pointers to call derived overrides.

rows.means: validates that a method overrides a virtual method in base class
rows.consequence: Prevents subtle bugs where a typo in a derived method name or signature silently creates a new method instead of overriding.

rows.means: prevents name collisions between libraries and modules
rows.consequence: Use explicit namespace qualification (e.g. std::vector) rather than using namespace std;, which causes global namespace pollution.

rows.means: type-safe null pointer literal, replacing the integer zero
rows.consequence: Has type std::nullptr_t, so a function overloaded on both an integer and a pointer is no longer ambiguous when passed a null pointer.

rows.means: compile-time type conversion / runtime checked polymorphic downcast
rows.consequence: dynamic_cast safely checks polymorphic class hierarchies at runtime, returning nullptr if the cast is invalid.

rows.means: container holding either a valid value or nothing (std::nullopt)
rows.consequence: Removes the need for a sentinel value — a negative number, or a null pointer — to mean that an operation produced no result.

rows.means: composable, lazy functional pipelines over collections
rows.consequence: auto res = vec | std::views::filter(is_even) | std::views::transform(square) executes lazily without allocating intermediate vectors.

rows.means: a mutual exclusion lock whose release is tied to scope
rows.consequence: lock_guard locks the mutex when it is constructed and unlocks it when the scope exits, so an early return or a thrown exception cannot leave it held.
